title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E13 — A Nice Place to Visit
While attending a friend's funeral, the A-Team encounters a crazed mountain clan. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E1 — Diamonds 'n' Dust
A mysterious woman (Kristen Meadows) wants her slain father's South African diamond mine freed from unscrupulous businessmen.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E2 — Recipe for Heavy Bread
The team members aid their former POW cook (Mako), an unwitting participant in drug smuggling; guest Marjoe Gortner.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E3 — The Only Church in Town
Face's former girlfriend (Markie Post), now a nun, hires the team to rescue nuns and orphans held in an Ecuadorean monastery.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E15 — Haunted
Banner helps a woman (Carol Baxter) deal with a tragedy from her childhood.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E19 — No Escape
After the Hulk innocently helps a dangerous man escape from the police, David has to correct his mistake.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E16 — Mystery Man
Amnesiac Banner and McGee are the only survivors of a wilderness plane crash.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E2 — Blind Rage
An accident at a chemical warfare research station sends David on a frantic race for an antidote to save his and a friend's life.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E20 — Kindred Spirits
Banner joins an archaeological dig to learn about a prehistoric Hulk; guests Kim Cattrall, A Martinez.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E18 — The Disciple
Banner's friend Li Sung (Mako) hands over the leadership of his group to a police officer; guests Rick Springfield, Gerald McRaney.

title: Knight Rider
description:

Devon discovers the connection between three murders and sends Michael and K.I.T.T. to pursue a ruthless loan shark.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 — Knight by a Nose
A vet tells a trainer her horse had to be destroyed.

title: Emergency!

DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!

title: Emergency!

DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!

The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!

Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!

The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.
